text: The dual space V* of an F-vector space V consists of:
choices: all invertible linear maps V → V
all bilinear maps V × V → F
all subspaces of V of codimension 1
explanation: V* = 𝓛(V, F) is the space of linear functionals (covectors). For finite-dimensional V a choice of basis gives the dual basis e^i with e^i(e_j) = δᵢⱼ, so dim V* = dim V.
